must_keep.quote: Air travel for journeys of less than 5 hours should be via economy class only.

For journeys of between 5 hours and 10 hours a business class flight may be purchased where: • bookings are not available in the lower class and the timing or date of the journey cannot be changed • if staff will be required to work immediately on arrival. • on disability/medical grounds.

design_notes: 300-minute nonstops: exactly 5 hours. Not 'less than 5 hours', so line 204 does not require economy; but the text does not say whether 'between 5 hours and 10 hours' (line 205) includes 5 hours. If it does, the traveller works on arrival and may have business; if not, no line allows business. Hold either reading's fare; line management approves travel outside the policy (lines 86-88).
